title: Indian Junior Team Prepares for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: The camp at Guwahati's NCE is crucial for India's young talents to prepare for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting a coaching camp for the Indian team ahead of the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026, focusing on developing young talent.

title: Final Selection Trials Announced for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: This announcement details the players eligible for the final selection trials to represent India at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: BAI has released the list of eligible players and details for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, set to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Who Follows Satwik-Chirag? India's Doubles Pipeline Under Scrutiny
indian_angle: Chief national coach Gopichand discusses the challenges and strategies for developing the next generation of world-class doubles players after the success of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty.
summary: Chief national coach Gopichand addresses the crucial question of developing a strong doubles pipeline in India to ensure continued success beyond the current top pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This circular announces a major change to the scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships, impacting young Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.

title: BAI Issues Advisory Against Unauthorized Badminton Leagues
indian_angle: BAI's advisory warns players and the public about participating in or promoting unauthorized badminton leagues and tournaments, safeguarding the sport's integrity in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued an advisory cautioning against participation in or promotion of unauthorized badminton leagues, tournaments, and championships.

title: Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Tournament in Chennai
indian_angle: This circular confirms the dates and venue for a significant All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament, providing a crucial platform for Indian senior players.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2026 is scheduled to take place in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, from July 16th to 23rd, 2026.
